candidates.claim: The IOS HTTP server is enabled on rtr-01 (ip http server enabled), but the management policy requires IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers to be disabled.
candidates.remediation: Disable the IOS HTTP server on rtr-01 (no ip http server) or reconcile the change with the approved baseline.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits any source to reach TCP/443 on fw-01's outside address 203.0.113.2, exposing an HTTPS management-protocol port on a non-MGMT interface, while policy allows HTTPS/ASDM only from MGMT on the fw-01 mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit for TCP/443 to 203.0.113.2 unless it is a documented public service, and keep firewall HTTPS management restricted to MGMT on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The baseline-delta record shows the rtr-01 ip http server setting changed from disabled in the approved baseline to enabled in the current configuration, and this deviation must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the ip http server change against the approved baseline and revert it to disabled unless an approved exception exists.
